authority: Source-authored whole companion diagnostics from the unchanged two SFC producers and authored exact descriptor ranges, before the new full public-before observation. Initial target-only corpus/source failures stay frozen; production is unchanged. Essential uses only with_essential, while Ecosystem extends with_happy_path; the initial broad-warning preset assumption and whole failed public attempt remain archived. The immutable n8n projection explicitly configures SFC element order error and script/template/style order; its complete separate projection vector is authored from that input and existing option/severity producers.
